helpers.inline: namespace Helpers { public static class VowelHelper { public static bool IsVowel(char c) { return "aeiouAEIOU".Contains(c); } } }
class VowelHelper { public static boolean isVowel(char c) { return "aeiouAEIOU".indexOf(c) != -1; } }
object VowelHelper { @JvmStatic fun isVowel(c: Char): Boolean = c.toLowerCase() in setOf('a', 'e', 'i', 'o', 'u') }

advancedTests.name: adv_test_helper
advancedTests.source: public static async System.Threading.Tasks.Task adv_test_helper() { if (!Helpers.VowelHelper.IsVowel('a')) throw new System.Exception("Vowel check failed"); await System.Threading.Tasks.Task.CompletedTask; }
